name: Barbell Single-Arm Landmine Row
steps: Stand alongside a bar secured at its far end and hinge over the free end with your knees soft.
Grip near the free end with one hand and draw your elbow back toward your hip.
Lower the bar along its arc until the arm hangs straight.
Switch sides after finishing this side.
tips: Keep your chest facing the floor rather than twisting your torso open to heave the bar.
Pull your elbow back toward your hip pocket rather than shrugging upward.
